posts.post:
the guy at the coffee shop wearing a ten-year-old sweater that fits perfectly.

that's the only aesthetic that matters.

the most expensive piece of clothing I own

is the one I haven't worn in two years.

why do we do that?
the problem with most modern clothing brands is that they design for the photo, not the movement.
three months in, and I still can't decide if the reinforced stitching on the cuff is a flex or overkill.
